description:
Add a shared "hand this to your agent" affordance: a copyable, plain-language brief written TO an agent, offered on the operator surfaces where a capable agent does the job faster than a human clicking. PHILOSOPHY §3 claims every capability is reachable programmatically and that we ship the affordances that make agents effective — this is that claim made visible in the product instead of asserted in a document.

STRICTLY ADDITIVE — operator ruling, 2026-08-12. Every surface keeps its existing UI in full. A brief is an extra path, never a replacement, and never a licence to simplify away a control to make room. A screen that loses a working affordance to fit a brief has failed this ticket. Even on People → import, where the brief leads visually, the file-drop stays and must work standalone.

WHAT A BRIEF CONTAINS — all four, or it is not paste-ready:
1. Where this instance lives — the real URL of the running deployment, never a placeholder.
2. The machine-readable entry point, told as an instruction: "read /api/openapi.json first".
3. The auth path — an API token, and where to mint one (Settings → API tokens).
4. A definition of done: what to report back, including any undo handle (e.g. import_id).

A brief that omits auth sends the operator's agent into a 401. A brief that omits the definition of done gets a "done!" with no receipt. Both are failures of this ticket, not of the agent.

SURFACES — one brief each, written for that job. These are copy, not a template with holes; a generic brief with the nouns swapped is a fail:
- People → import (already prototyped: prototypes/crm/index.html, the "Import people" modal — reproduce it one-to-one)
- CFP setup → build a call for papers from a description of the conference
- Communications / chase → find who is behind and send the right nudge
- Agenda builder → place the accepted sessions, respecting conflicts
- Speaker portal, organizer side → prepare and send a speaker's onboarding

SHAPE: one shared presentational component (brief text + full-width Copy button + the muted "or drive it yourself" endpoint line), five pieces of per-surface copy. Clipboard via navigator.clipboard with a visible confirmation; a select-all fallback where it is unavailable. Voice per DESIGN.md — the brief is written as the operator would speak to their own agent, first person, no exclamation marks.

BOUNDARIES: no new dependencies. Not a chat panel, not an in-app assistant, no model is called and nothing leaves the browser — Marquee renders text the operator copies. The endpoint reference stays a muted single line, not a second code block.

READ FIRST: PHILOSOPHY.md §3; DESIGN.md (voice, craft rules); prototypes/crm/index.html "Import people" modal; SKILL.md and cli/generate-skill.mjs for the vocabulary the briefs should echo.

PROCESS: fresh worktree off github/main; PR via gh pr create --repo Stage-11-Agentics/marquee --base main. Post-deadline scope — do not merge before the competition freeze clears (cf. MRQ-105).
title: Hand this to your agent — copyable agent briefs on operator surfaces
